tasks.short: Write the actual geography research grant proposal

steps.what: Read the actual funding call, original geographical research sources and institutional cost requirements; capture exact source and form mappings
inputs: Actual funding call and original research sources
outputs: Read original requirements and explicit source/form/cost mapping with gaps

steps.what: Choose the actual research question, geographical methods, field/data work, partner contributions and realistic resource quantities
inputs: Original requirements and evidence from s1
Actual research intentions and partner/resource constraints
outputs: Teacher-selected actual research design and explicit resource quantities

inputs: Selected work and quantities from s2
outputs: Draft fixed proposal fields and exact budget with unresolved costs flagged

steps.what: Write the actual grant narrative with bounded wording proposals grounded in the selected research design and original sources
inputs: Actual selected research design from s2
outputs: Actual draft source-linked research grant narrative

loop.purpose: Propose wording for the teacher's actual selected research proposal
loop.input: Actual chosen research design and original evidence
loop.check: Teacher checks novelty claims, methods, every source and feasibility against actual research intent
loop.stop: Unsupported source, invented result or changed research commitment stays manual and blocks submission
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed form fields/budget are s3; expressing the actual argument requires semantic checking

steps.what: Check the entire actual proposal, attachments, research claims, budget and stated commitments and produce the exact final submission package
outputs: Exact complete checked final proposal package

steps.what: Save the final review package in the same document workspace without submitting it
outputs: Stored exact final review proposal

steps.what: Perform the actual existing institutional grant review of the complete final proposal and its commitments and decide whether that exact package may be submitted
outputs: Institutional release for the exact proposal or rejection

steps.what: Submit only the exact institutionally authorised proposal package to the actual external funder through its existing portal
outputs: Actual funder submission acknowledgment or failed submission

tasks.design: Assemble exact proposal fields and budget in {DOCS}/{SPREADSHEET}, then help word the teacher's selected geography research design. Retain complete proposal checking and existing institutional final review before the separate {GOV_PORTAL}/{PARTNER_PORTAL} submission.

tasks.enabler_now: Explicit call/form mappings support fixed assembly and budget arithmetic; source-bound wording proposals are checkable against the actual design.
tasks.still_hard: Original research value, feasible methods and real institutional commitments require the researchers and actual authority.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher owns the actual research question and its scholarly justification.

ambition.what: Write and submit the actual proposal with less repetitive assembly, not a promised funding increase.
